title: Warranty Coverage Appointment Standards: Arrival Windows, Visit Offer Times and Missed-Visit Fees
content:
Standards for booking technician visits under Ridgeline Warranty Coverage: how soon a visit is offered after approval, how long the arrival window is, how long the technician waits for access, and the fee and free allowance for missed visits.

## Visit offer and arrival

| Plan | Visit offered within (business days after the claim is approved) | Arrival window (hours) | Technician waits for access (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 15 | 4 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 15 | 4 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 10 | 4 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 10 | 4 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 7 | 4 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 5 | 4 | 30 |

## Missed visits

| Plan | No-show fee (USD) | Missed visits per registration waived before the fee applies |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 95.00 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 95.00 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 95.00 | 1 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 75.00 | 1 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 75.00 | 1 |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 75.00 | 1 |

- The no-show fee is the fee when nobody gives the technician access within the wait time of a booked visit.
- The free no-show count is the number of missed service visits per registration that are waived before the no-show fee applies.

## Points of reference

**How long is the wait before a visit counts as missed?** 30 minutes in every plan.

**Which plans waive no missed visit at all?** The Ridgeline Limited Warranty and the Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty, whose free no-show count is 0.
